

local function appendPacked(destination, offset, ...)
    local values=table.pack(...)
    table.move(values,1,values.n,offset+1,destination)
end
local function unpackPacked(values) return table.unpack(values,1,values.n) end
local function readCapturedCell(cell,offset) return cell[5][cell[4]+offset] end

local NativeFactories={}

NativeFactories[2] = 
function(moduleContext, premiumTarget, premiumFlag)
    local s = moduleContext

    local F = s.load("c")
    local z = s.load("d")

    local function g(a, H)
        local t = a:FindFirstChild(H)
        if t then
            if t:IsA("BasePart") then
                return t
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function a(H, t, Y, N, O, h)
        return (H and E(t, Y, (N - O) / h)) or t
    end
    local H = {}
    H.__index = H
    H.new = function(t)
        local Y = C.fakes[t]
        local N, O, h = setmetatable({plr = t, fake = Y ~= nil, vp = Y and Y.vp, nick = (Y and Y.nick) or t.Name, bin = {}, cache = {}, valid = false, ph = math.random(), rs = {}, ro = {}, gn = {}, gd = {}, gl = {}, memo = {}, ct = {}, sp = {}, pts = {}}, H), F.gui, Instance.new("ImageLabel")

    H.make = function(t, Y, N)
        local O = z.new(Y, t.fake)
        for z, Y in N, nil, nil do
            pcall(T, O, z, Y)
        end
        O.Visible = false
        N = t.bin
        N[#N + 1] = O
        return O
    end
    H.watch = function(z, T)
        z:unwatch()
        if not (T) then
            return
        end
        local function t(Y)
            if L[Y.Name] then
                z.valid = false
            end
        end
        z.c1 = T.ChildAdded:Connect(t)
        z.c2 = T.ChildRemoved:Connect(t)
    end
    H.unwatch = function(z)
        if z.c1 then
            z.c1:Disconnect()
            z.c1 = nil
        end
        if z.c2 then
            z.c2:Disconnect()
            z.c2 = nil
        end
    end
    H.rebuild = function(z)
        local T = z.cache
        u(T)
        local t = z.char
        if t then
            if not (t.Parent) then
                return
            end
        else
            return
        end
        local Y = 0
        for N, O in t:GetChildren() do
            if L[O.Name] then
                if O:IsA("BasePart") then
                    N = O.Size
                    if N.X ~= 0 then
                        local L = Y + 1
                        T[L] = O
                        Y = L
                    else
                        if N.Y ~= 0 then
                            local L = Y + 1
                            T[L] = O
                            Y = L
                        else
                            if N.Z ~= 0 then
                                local L = Y + 1
                                T[L] = O
                                Y = L
                            else
                            end
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
            else
            end
        end
        z.valid = true
    end
    H.check = function(z)
        local L = z.char
        if L then
            if L.Parent then
                if not (z.valid) then
                    return false
                end
            else
                return false
            end
        else
            return false
        end
        local T = z.cache
        z = #T
        if z == 0 then
            return false
        end
        for t = 1, r(3, z), 1 do
            if T[t].Parent ~= L then
                return false
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    H.joints = function(z)
        local L, T = z.char, z.sp
        if (z.spc ~= L) or not z.valid then
            z.spc = L
            for t, Y in G, nil, nil do
                T[t] = g(L, Y[1]) or (Y[2] and g(L, Y[2]))
            end
        end
        L = T.hd
        if L then
            if not (L.Parent) then
                z.sk = nil
                return
            end
        else
            z.sk = nil
            return
        end
        L = z.pts
        u(L)
        for G, g in T, nil, nil do
            if g.Parent then
                L[G] = g.CFrame.Position
            end
        end
        z.sk = L
    end
    H.project = function(z, L)
        local T, G = z.view, z.vp
        if G then
            z = G.AbsoluteSize
            if z.X < 1 then
                return B, false, 0
            elseif z.Y < 1 then
                return B, false, 0
            end
            local g = T.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(L)
            if g.Z > -0.05 then
                return B, false, 0
            end
            local B, t, Y = -g.Z, P(_(T.FieldOfView * 0.5)), G.AbsolutePosition + j:GetGuiInset()
            return b(Y.X + (z.X * (0.5 + ((g.X / ((B * t) * (z.X / z.Y))) * 0.5))), Y.Y + (z.Y * (0.5 - ((g.Y / (B * t)) * 0.5)))), true, B
        end
        local z, j = A(T, L)
        return b(z.X, z.Y), j, z.Z
    end
    H.upd = function(z)
        local L = z.plr
        if not (L.Parent) then
            z.en = false
            z.vis = false
            if z.char then
                z.char = nil
                z.hd = nil
                z.sk = nil
                z.valid = false
                u(z.cache)
                z:unwatch()
            end
            return
        end
        local T, j = F.share(L), C.set
        L = T.char
        if L ~= z.char then
            z.char = L
            z.hd = nil
            z.sk = nil
            z.dir = nil
            z.valid = false
            u(z.cache)
            z:watch(L)
        end
        z.rk = T.role
        local A, P = T.on
        if A then
            local _ = j.only
            P = (if _ then T.role ~= "inno" else not _) or z.fake
        else
            P = A
        end
        z.en = P
        if not (P) then
            z.vis = false
            z.valid = false
            z.sk = nil
            return
        end
        T = z.hd
        if if T then T.Parent ~= L else not T then
            T = L:FindFirstChild("Head")
            z.hd = T
        else
        end
        if not T then
            z.vis = false
            z.valid = false
            z.sk = nil
            u(z.cache)
            return
        end
        L, A = s.cam, z.vp
        if A then
            if not (x.VISUALS_TAB_OPEN) then
                z.vis = false
                return
            end
            L = A.CurrentCamera or L
        else
        end
        z.view = L
        local x = T.Position
        local P, _, B = z:project(x)
        z.vis = _
        z.range = B
        if _ then
            if j.skel then
                z:joints()
            else
                z.sk = nil
            end
            T = z.cache
            if #T == 0 then
                z:rebuild()
            elseif not (z.valid) then
                z:rebuild()
            end
            if #T == 0 then
                z.vis = false
                return
            end
            local _, G = F.bounds(T)
            if not (_) then
                z.vis = false
                z.valid = false
                return
            end
            z.corn = (A and F.framed(_, G, L, A)) or F.corners(_, G, z.ct)
        elseif j.arrows then
            if not (z.fake) then
                local T = P - (s.vs * 0.5)
                T = if B <= 0 then -T else T
                local j = T.Magnitude
                if j > 0.001 then
                    z.dir = T / j
                else
                    local T = L.CFrame
                    local L = W(T.Position, T.RightVector, J):PointToObjectSpace(x)
                    T = b(L.X, L.Z)
                    L = T.Magnitude
                    z.dir = (((L > 0.001) and (T / L)) or z.dir) or b(0, -1)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    H.mute = function(z, z)
        if z.on then
            z.on = false
            for L = 1, #z, 1 do
                z[L].Visible = false
            end
        end
    end
    H.hide = function(z)
        local L = z.bin
        for T = 1, #L, 1 do

    H.rect = function(z, L, T, x, j, A, P, _, W, B)
        if A <= 0 then
            return T
        elseif P <= 0 then
            return T
        end
        local J = L[T]
        if J then
        else
            J = z:make("Square", {Filled = true, ZIndex = B})
            L[T] = J
        end
        J.Position = b(x, j)
        J.Size = b(A, P)
        J.Color = _
        J.Transparency = W
        D(J, B)
        J.Visible = true
        L.on = true
        return T + 1
    end
    H.corners = function(z, L, T, x, j, A, P)
        local _, W, B, J, G, g = z.rs, z.ro, L.tl.X, L.tl.Y, L.br.X - 1, L.br.Y - 1
        local t, Y = (G - B) + 1, (g - J) + 1
        if (t <= 0) or (Y <= 0) then
            z:mute(_)
            z:mute(W)
            return
        end
        local N, O, h = c(e(t * 0.25), 1), c(e(Y * 0.25), 1), g - J
        h = if h <= 0 then 1 else h
        Y = 1
        if P then
            t, L = P[1], P[2]
            Y = z:rect(W, z:rect(W, z:rect(W, z:rect(W, z:rect(W, z:rect(W, z:rect(W, z:rect(W, Y, B - 1, J - 1, N + 2, 3, t, L, 100), G - N, J - 1, N + 2, 3, t, L, 100), B - 1, g - 1, N + 2, 3, t, L, 100), G - N, g - 1, N + 2, 3, t, L, 100), B - 1, J - 1, 3, O + 2, t, L, 100), G - 1, J - 1, 3, O + 2, t, L, 100), B - 1, g - O, 3, O + 2, t, L, 100), G - 1, g - O, 3, O + 2, t, L, 100)
        else
        end
        t, P = a(j, T, x, J, J, h), a(j, T, x, g, J, h)
        local L, l = z:rect(_, z:rect(_, z:rect(_, z:rect(_, 1, B, J, N, 1, t, A, 101), (G - N) + 1, J, N, 1, t, A, 101), B, g, N, 1, P, A, 101), (G - N) + 1, g, N, 1, P, A, 101), (j and r(6, O)) or 1
        for Z = 1, l, 1 do
            N, P = e((O * (Z - 1)) / l), e((O * Z) / l)
            P = if P <= N then N + 1 else P
            local O, l, q, o = J + N, J + P, (g - P) + 1, (g - N) + 1
            Z, t = a(j, T, x, (O + l) * 0.5, J, h), a(j, T, x, (q + o) * 0.5, J, h)
            L = z:rect(_, z:rect(_, z:rect(_, z:rect(_, L, B, O, 1, l - O, Z, A, 101), G, O, 1, l - O, Z, A, 101), B, q, 1, o - q, t, A, 101), G, q, 1, o - q, t, A, 101)
        end
        for z = L, #_, 1 do
            _[z].Visible = false
        end
        for z = Y, #W, 1 do
            W[z].Visible = false
        end
    end
    H.gbox = function(z, L, T, x, j)
        local A, P, _, W, B = z.rs, L.tl.X, L.tl.Y, L.br.X - 1, L.br.Y - 1
        local L, J = (W - P) + 1, (B - _) + 1
        z:mute(z.ro)
        if L <= 0 then
            z:mute(A)
            return
        elseif J <= 0 then
            z:mute(A)
            return
        end
        local G, g = r(24, J), (z:rect(A, z:rect(A, 1, P, _, L, 1, T, j, 101), P, B, L, 1, x, j, 101))
        for a = 1, G, 1 do
            L, B = e((J * (a - 1)) / G), e((J * a) / G)
            B = if B <= L then L + 1 else B
            a = E(T, x, ((L + B) * 0.5) / J)
            g = z:rect(A, z:rect(A, g, P, _ + L, 1, B - L, a, j, 101), W, _ + L, 1, B - L, a, j, 101)
        end
        for z = g, #A, 1 do
            A[z].Visible = false
        end
    end
    H.grad = function(z, L, T, x, j, A, e, P, _, E)
        local W = z.memo[L]
        if W then
        else
            W = {c = {}, s = {}, f = {}, w = {}}
            z.memo[L] = W
        end
        local B, J, G, g, a, t = W.c, W.s, W.f, W.w, #T, 0
        for W = 1, a, 1 do
            local Y = L[W]
            if Y then
            else
                Y = z:make("Text", {Center = false, Outline = true, OutlineColor = n})
                L[W] = Y
            end
            local n = w(T, W)
            if ((B[W] ~= n) or (J[W] ~= A)) or (G[W] ~= e) then
                if J[W] ~= A then
                    Y.Size = A
                    J[W] = A
                end
                if G[W] ~= e then
                    Y.Font = e
                    G[W] = e
                end
                if B[W] ~= n then
                    local T = f[n]
                    if T then
                    else
                        T = m(n)
                        f[n] = T
                    end
                    Y.Text = T
                    B[W] = n
                end
                g[W] = Y.TextBounds.X
            end
            t += g[W]
        end
        for T = a + 1, #L, 1 do
            L[T].Visible = false
        end
        e, B = x - (t * 0.5), z.ph
        for z = 1, a, 1 do
            A = L[z]
            A.Color = v(_, E, ((a > 1) and ((z - 1) / (a - 1))) or 0, B)
            A.Transparency = P
            A.Position = b(e, j)
            A.Visible = true
            e += g[z]
        end
        L.on = true
    end
    H.point = function(z, L)
        local v, T = z.arc, z.dir
        if L.arrows then
            if T then
                if z.fake then
                    v.Visible = false
                    return
                end
            else
                v.Visible = false
                return
            end
        else
            v.Visible = false
            return
        end
        local n, x = F.arrow(), K((T.X * T.X) + (T.Y * T.Y))
        if n == "" then
            v.Visible = false
            return
        elseif x <= 0.0001 then
            v.Visible = false
            return
        end
        local F, j = s.vs, L.arrow_size
        local s, A = F.X * 0.5, F.Y * 0.5
        local F, e, K, P, _ = r(L.arrow_dist, c(0, r(s, A) - (j * 0.5))), T.X / x, T.Y / x, L.arrow_col[z.rk], z.ari
        v.Size = U(d(j), d(j))
        v.Position = U(d(s + (e * F)), d(A + (K * F)))
        if _.Image ~= n then
            _.Image = n
        end
        _.Rotation = X(y(K, e)) + 90
        _.ImageColor3 = P[1]
        _.ImageTransparency = 1 - P[2]
        v.Visible = true
    end
    H.ren = function(F)
        if not (F.en) then
            if not (F.blank) then
                F.blank = true
                F:hide()
            end
            return
        end
        F.blank = false
        local s = C.set
        if not (F.vis) then
            if not (F.off) then
                F.off = true
                F:hide()
            end
            F:point(s)
            return
        end
        F.off = false
        F.arc.Visible = false
        local z = F.corn
        local C, L = z.tl, z.br
        local v, T, n, x, j, A, e, c, r, K = (C.X + z.tr.X) * 0.5, C.Y, z.bl.Y, s.size, s.font, F.box, F.edge, F.fill, F.rs, F.ro
        if s.box then
            if s.box_type == "Corners" then
                A.Visible = false
                e.Visible = false
                local X = s.box_grd
                F:corners(z, (X and s.box_grd_col[1]) or s.box_col[1], s.box_grd_col[2], X, s.box_col[2], s.box_out and s.box_out_col)
            else
                if s.box_grd then
                    A.Visible = false
                    F:gbox(z, s.box_grd_col[1], s.box_grd_col[2], s.box_col[2])
                else
                    F:mute(r)
                    F:mute(K)
                    A.Position = C
                    A.Size = L - C
                    A.Color = s.box_col[1]
                    A.Transparency = s.box_col[2]
                    D(A, 101)
                    A.Visible = true
                end
                if s.box_out then
                    local X = s.box_out_col
                    e.Position = C
                    e.Size = L - C
                    e.Color = X[1]
                    e.Transparency = X[2]
                    D(e, 100)
                    e.Visible = true
                else
                    e.Visible = false
                end
            end
        else
            A.Visible = false
            e.Visible = false
            F:mute(r)
            F:mute(K)
        end
        r = F.gf
        if s.box then
            if s.fill then
                if s.fill_grd then
                    c.Visible = false
                    r.Position = U(C.X, C.Y)
                    r.Size = U(L.X - C.X, L.Y - C.Y)
                    K = s.fill_grd_col
                    if (F.ga ~= K[1]) or (F.gb ~= K[2]) then
                        F.ga, F.gb = K[1], K[2]
                        F.gfg.Color = ColorSequence.new(K[1], K[2])
                    end
                    r.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - s.fill_col[2]
                    r.Visible = true
                else
                    r.Visible = false
                    c.Position = C
                    c.Size = L - C
                    c.Color = s.fill_col[1]
                    c.Transparency = s.fill_col[2]
                    c.Visible = true
                end
            else
                r.Visible = false
                c.Visible = false
            end
        else
            r.Visible = false
            c.Visible = false
        end
        K, r = F.tag
        if s.name then
            e = (s.name_disp and F.plr.DisplayName) or F.nick
            K.Size = x
            K.Font = j
            K.Text = e
            r = K.TextBounds
            A = (T - r.Y) - 2
            if s.name_grd then
                K.Visible = false
                F:grad(F.gn, e, v, A, x, j, s.name_col[2], s.name_grd_col[1], s.name_grd_col[2])
            else
                F:mute(F.gn)
                K.Color = s.name_col[1]
                K.Transparency = s.name_col[2]
                K.Position = b(v, A)
                K.Visible = true
            end
        else
            K.Visible = false
            F:mute(F.gn)
        end
        K = F.av
        if s.avatar then
            A = x + 6
            K.Size = U(A, A)
            C = F.plr.UserId
            if F.uid ~= C then
                F.uid = C
                K.Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. (C .. "&w=48&h=48")
            end
            if r then
                K.Position = U(((v + (r.X * 0.5)) + (A * 0.5)) + 4, (T - (r.Y * 0.5)) - 2)
            else
                K.Position = U(v, (T - (A * 0.5)) - 2)
            end
            K.Visible = true
        else
            K.Visible = false
        end
        z, T, L = F.flag, F.rk, 0
        if s.flags and (T ~= "inno") then
            A, e, K = ((T == "mur") and "MURDERER") or "SHERIFF", s.flag_col[T], n + 2
            z.Size = x
            z.Font = j
            z.Text = A
            if s.flag_grd[T] then
                r = s.flag_grd_col[T]
                z.Visible = false
                F:grad(F.gl, A, v, K, x, j, e[2], r[1], r[2])
            else
                F:mute(F.gl)
                z.Color = e[1]
                z.Transparency = e[2]
                z.Position = b(v, K)
                z.Visible = true
            end
            L = z.TextBounds.Y
        else
            z.Visible = false
            F:mute(F.gl)
        end
        C = F.dist
        if s.dist then
            e = d(F.range)
            if F.dr ~= e then
                F.dr = e
                F.ds = e .. " studs"
            end
            A, r = F.ds, (n + 2) + L
            C.Size = x
            C.Font = j
            C.Text = A
            if s.dist_grd then
                C.Visible = false
                F:grad(F.gd, A, v, r, x, j, s.dist_col[2], s.dist_grd_col[1], s.dist_grd_col[2])
            else
                F:mute(F.gd)
                C.Color = s.dist_col[1]
                C.Transparency = s.dist_col[2]
                C.Position = b(v, r)
                C.Visible = true
            end
        else
            C.Visible = false
            F:mute(F.gd)
        end
        v, K = F.skel, F.sk
        if s.skel and K then
            F.skoff = false
            L, j = s.skel_col[1], s.skel_col[2]
            for s = 1, 10, 1 do
                r, A = v[s], M[s]
                s, n = K[A[1]], K[A[2]]
                if s then
                    if n then
                        C, z = F:project(s)
                        e, T = F:project(n)
                        if z then
                            if T then
                                r.From = C
                                r.To = e
                                r.Color = L
                                r.Transparency = j
                                r.Visible = true
                            else
                                r.Visible = false
                            end
                        else
                            r.Visible = false
                        end
                    else
                        r.Visible = false
                    end
                else
                    r.Visible = false
                end
            end
        elseif not (F.skoff) then
            F.skoff = true
            for F = 1, 10, 1 do
                v[F].Visible = false
            end
        end
    end
    H.dest = function(F)
        local s = F.bin
        for z = 1, #s, 1 do
            s[z]:Remove()
        end
        F.av:Destroy()
        F.gf:Destroy()
        F.arc:Destroy()
        F:unwatch()
        u(F)
    end
    return H
end)()
end

NativeFactories[4] = 
function(moduleContext, premiumTarget, premiumFlag)
    local s = moduleContext
    return (function()
    local F = s.load("c")
    local z = s.load("d")
    local C = s.load("e")
    local L = s.load("f")
    local v = s.load("a")
    local s = F.players
    local D = F.space
    local T = F.rt
    local n, x, j, A, e, d = table.clear, {}, {}, {}, 1, 0
    local function c(r)
        x[r] = {C.new(r), L.new(r)}
    end
    local function C(r)
        local K = x[r]
        if K then
            x[r] = nil
            K[1]:dest()
            K[2]:dest()
        end
    end
    local function r(K)
        T.frame = T.frame + 1
        local X = D.CurrentCamera
        if X then
            T.cam = X
            T.vs = X.ViewportSize
        end
        z.step()
        for z, D in x, nil, nil do
            z, X = D[1], D[2]
            z:upd()
            z:ren()
            X:upd(K)
            X:ren()
        end
    end
    local function z(D)
        d += D
        if d < 0.1 then
            return
        end
        d = 0
        n(A)
        D = 0
        for T in x, nil, nil do
            D += 1
            A[D] = T
        end
        if D == 0 then
            return
        end
        local T = math.max(1, math.ceil(D / 10))
        for d = 1, T, 1 do
            e += 1
            if e > D then
                e = 1
            end
            d = x[A[e]]
            if d then
                if not (d[1]:check()) then
                    d[1].valid = false
                end
            end
        end
    end
    v.load = function()
        if v.loaded then
            return
        end
        F.mount()
        for D, D in s:GetPlayers() do
            c(D)
        end
        j[1] = s.PlayerAdded:Connect(c)
        j[2] = s.PlayerRemoving:Connect(C)
        j[3] = F.run.RenderStepped:Connect(r)
        j[4] = F.run.Heartbeat:Connect(z)
        v.loaded = true
    end
    v.unload = function()
        if not (v.loaded) then
            return
        end
        v.loaded = false
        for s = #j, 1, -1 do
            j[s]:Disconnect()
            j[s] = nil
        end
        for s in x, nil, nil do
            C(s)
        end
        n(v.fakes)
        n(A)
        L.reset()
        F.unmount()
    end
    v.clone = function(F, s, z)
        if not (v.loaded) then
            return nil
        end
        local L = {Character = F, DisplayName = s.DisplayName, Name = "__CLONE__" .. s.Name, UserId = s.UserId, Parent = s.Parent}
        v.fakes[L] = {vp = z, nick = s.Name}
        c(L)
        return L
    end
    v.reclone = function(F, s)
        if v.loaded then
            if F then
                if v.fakes[F] then
                    F.Character = s
                end
            end
        end
    end
    v.unclone = function(F)
        if v.loaded then
            if not (F) then
                return
            end
        else
            return
        end
        C(F)
        v.fakes[F] = nil
    end
    return v
end)()
end

        local function T(E, t, Y)
            local l = {}

                    end
                end
                return nil

        local function e(E, J, t)
            local Y = {}
            Y.name = J.name
            Y.raw = J
            Y.own = t
            Y.sec = function(l, Z)
                if type(Z) == "table" then

                    l.side = l.side or "left"

                end

            Y.panel = function(T, l, Z)

                T = {"callback", "list", "state", "pick", "open", "tap"}
                for d, d in ipairs(T) do
                    if type(Z[d]) == "function" then
                        Z[d] = G(E, Z[d], l)
                    end
                end
                if type(Z.buttons) == "table" then
                    T = {}
                    for d, q in ipairs(Z.buttons) do
                        T[d] = {icon = q.icon, tip = q.tip, fn = ((type(q.fn or q.callback) == "function") and G(E, q.fn or q.callback, l)) or nil}
                    end
                    Z.buttons = T
                end
                if l ~= "files" then
                    if l ~= "clone" then
                        if Z.flag ~= nil then
                            Z.flag = "lua/" .. (E.name .. ("/" .. tostring(Z.flag)))
                        end
                    end
                end
                T = J[l](J, Z)
                table.insert(E.secs, T)
                return T
            end
            Y.sub = function(T, d)
                if type(J.sub) ~= "function" then
                    return nil
                end
                if type(d) == "table" then
                    T = J:sub({name = d.name or "sub", icon = d.icon or "circle-dot", tip = d.tip or ""})
                    table.insert(E.tabs, T)
                    if type(J.setopen) == "function" then
                        pcall(J.setopen, J, true)
                    end
                    return e(E, T, true)
                end
                d = M(d)
                for T, T in ipairs(J.subs) do
                    if M(T.name) == d then
                        return e(E, T)
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end
            Y.subs = function(T)
                T = {}
                for d, d in ipairs(J.subs or {}) do
                    T[#T + 1] = d.name
                end
                return T
            end
            Y.select = function(T)
                J:select()
                return Y
            end
            Y.kill = function(T)
                T = t and table.find(E.tabs, J)
                if T then
                    table.remove(E.tabs, T)
                    J:kill()
                end
            end
            return Y
        end
        local function T(d)
            if type(d) == "table" then
                return (d.rec or (d.raw and d.raw.rec)) or nil
            end
            local E = tostring(d)
            for J, J in ipairs(z.els) do
                if J.id == E then
                    return J
                end
            end
            d = M(E)
            if string.find(d, "/", 1, true) then
                for J, J in ipairs(z.els) do
                    E = M(string.gsub(J.tab, "|", "/") .. ("/" .. (J.sec.name .. ("/" .. tostring(J.name)))))
                    if E == d then
                        return J
                    elseif string.sub(E, -#d - 1) == ("/" .. d) then
                        return J
                    end
                end
            end
            for E, E in ipairs(z.els) do
                if M(E.name) == d then
                    return E
                elseif M(E.id) == d then
                    return E
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        local d
        local function E(J)
            local t = {}
            t.name = J.name
            t.lib = z
            t.ui = C
            t.root = L
            t.ctx = s
            t.esp, t.round, t.aim, t.motion, t.fx, t.mods, t.menus = s.esp, s.round, s.aim, s.motion, s.fx, s.mods, s.menus
            t.env = v
            t.lp = j
            t.dir = "shitarolua"
            t.chat, t.tags = s.chat, s.tags
            t.svc = function(C)
                return game:GetService(C)
            end
            t.tab = function(C)
                if type(C) == "table" then
                    local Y = L:tab({name = tostring(C.name or J.name), icon = C.icon or "code", tip = C.tip or ""})
                    table.insert(J.tabs, Y)
                    return e(J, Y, true)
                end
                C = M(C)
                for Y, Y in ipairs(L.list) do
                    if M(Y.name) == C then
                        return e(J, Y)
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end
            t.tabs = function()
                local C = {}
                for e, e in ipairs(L.list) do
                    C[#C + 1] = e.name
                end
                return C
            end
            t.el = function(C)
                local e = T(C)
                return (e and m(J, e)) or nil
            end
            t.els = function(C)
                local e, Y = {}, C and (M(C))
                for l, l in ipairs(z.els) do
                    C = string.gsub(l.tab, "|", "/") .. ("/" .. (l.sec.name .. ("/" .. tostring(l.name))))
                    if Y then
                        if string.find(M(C), Y, 1, true) then
                            e[#e + 1] = C
                        end
                    else
                        e[#e + 1] = C
                    end
                end
                return e
            end
            t.get = function(C)
                local e = T("lua/" .. (J.name .. ("/" .. tostring(C)))) or T(C)
                if e then
                    return m(J, e):get()
                end
                e = z.pool[tostring(C)]
                if e then
                    if e.get then
                        return e.get()
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end
            t.set = function(C, e)
                local Y = T("lua/" .. (J.name .. ("/" .. tostring(C)))) or T(C)
                if Y then
                    m(J, Y):set(e)
                    return true
                end
                Y = z.pool[tostring(C)]
                if Y then
                    if Y.set then
                        Y.set(e)
                        return true
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            t.on = function(C, T)
                local e = O(J, C, T)
                return {off = function()
                    local C = table.find(J.subs, e)
                    if C then
                        table.remove(J.subs, C)
                        h(e)
                    end
                end}
            end
            t.once = function(C, T)
                local e
                e = t.on(C, function(...)
                    e.off()
                    return T(...)
                end)
                return e
            end
            t.emit = function(C, ...)
                H(M(C), ...)
            end
            t.hook = function(C, T, e)
                return n(J, C, T, e)
            end
            t.conn = function(C, T)
                local n = C:Connect(G(J, T))
                table.insert(J.cs, n)
                return n
            end
            t.spawn = function(C, ...)
                return x(J, task.spawn(G(J, C), ...))
            end
            t.delay = function(C, T, ...)
                return x(J, task.delay(C, G(J, T), ...))
            end
            t.loop = function(C, T)
                local n = G(J, T, "loop")
                return t.spawn(function()
                    while not J.dead do
                        if n() == false then
                            break
                        end
                        task.wait(C)
                    end
                end)
            end
            t.track = function(C)
                table.insert(J.objs, C)
                return C
            end
            t.unload = function(C)
                if type(C) == "function" then
                    table.insert(J.fns, C)
                    return
                end
                if r[J.name] == J then
                    d(J.name)
                    g("lua", "disabled " .. J.name)
                    f.paint()
                end
            end
            t.notify = function(C, T, n)
                pcall(z.notify, z, {title = J.name, text = tostring(C), icon = "code", life = T or 4, tone = n})
            end
            t.log = function(...)
                g(J.name, ...)
                print("[lua:" .. (J.name .. "]"), ...)
            end
            t.role = function(C)
                return s.round.role(C or j)
            end
            t.alive = function(C)
                return s.round.alive(C or j)
            end
            t.murderer = function()
                return s.round.murderer()
            end
            t.sheriff = function()
                for C, T in ipairs(PlayersService:GetPlayers()) do
                    C = s.round.role(T)
                    if (C == "Sheriff") or (C == "Hero") then
                        if s.round.alive(T) then
                            return T
                        end
                    end
                end
                for C, C in ipairs(PlayersService:GetPlayers()) do
                    if s.round.stored(C, "Gun") then
                        return C
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end
            return t
        end
        d = function(s)
            local C = r[s]
            if not (C) then
                return false
            end
            r[s] = nil
            for D = #C.fns, 1, -1 do
                local T, n = pcall(C.fns[D])
                if not (T) then
                    g(s, "unload error: " .. tostring(n))
                end
            end
            C.dead = true
            s = coroutine.running()
            if C.th then
                if C.th ~= s then
                    pcall(task.cancel, C.th)
                end
            end
            for D, D in ipairs(C.ths) do
                if D ~= s then
                    pcall(task.cancel, D)
                end
            end
            for s, s in ipairs(C.cs) do
                pcall(function()
                    s:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            for s, s in ipairs(C.subs) do
                h(s)
            end
            for s = #C.hks, 1, -1 do
                pcall(C.hks[s].off)
            end
            for s, s in ipairs(C.taps) do
                pcall(s.off)
            end
            for s, D in pairs(C.vis) do
                pcall(function()
                    s.item.row.Visible = D
                end)
            end
            for s, D in pairs(C.svis) do
                pcall(s.seek.slot.show, D)
            end
            for s = #C.els, 1, -1 do
                pcall(C.els[s].item.kill, C.els[s].item)
            end
            for s = #C.grows, 1, -1 do
                pcall(C.grows[s].shrink, C.grows[s])
            end
            for s = #C.secs, 1, -1 do
                pcall(C.secs[s].kill)
            end
            for s = #C.tabs, 1, -1 do
                pcall(C.tabs[s].kill, C.tabs[s])
            end
            for s, s in ipairs(C.objs) do
                pcall(function()
                    if typeof(s) == "Instance" then
                        s:Destroy()
                    elseif typeof(s) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
                        s:Disconnect()
                    elseif type(s) == "thread" then
                        task.cancel(s)
                    elseif type(s) == "function" then
                        s()
                    elseif type(s) == "table" then
                        if type(s.Destroy) == "function" then
                            s:Destroy()
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            return true
        end
        local function s()
            local C, D = {}, {}
            if ((type(listfiles) == "function") and (type(isfolder) == "function")) and (type(makefolder) == "function") then
                local T, n = pcall(isfolder, "shitarolua")
                if T then
                    if not (n) then
                        pcall(makefolder, "shitarolua")
                    end
                else
                    pcall(makefolder, "shitarolua")
                end
                n, T = pcall(listfiles, "shitarolua")
                if n and (type(T) == "table") then
                    for n, x in ipairs(T) do
                        n = tostring(x)
                        local T, x = string.match(string.gsub(n, "\\", "/"), "([^/]+)%.(%w+)$")
                        if T then
                            if A[M(x)] then
                                if not (D[T]) then
                                    D[T] = n
                                    C[#C + 1] = T
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for T in pairs(r) do
                if not (D[T]) then
                    C[#C + 1] = T
                end
            end
            table.sort(C, function(T, n)
                return M(T) < M(n)
            end)
            return C, D
        end
        f.paint = function()
            if W then
                pcall(W.paint, W)
            end
        end
        f.rescan = function(C)
            local D, T = s()
            local s = table.concat(D, "\001")
            X = T
            if C or (s ~= U) then
                U, y = s, D
                if W then
                    pcall(W.refresh, W, D)
                end
            end
            s = y
            return s
        end
        f.boot = function(s)
            if r[s] then
                return true
            end
            local C = X[s]
            if C then
            else
                f.rescan(true)
                C = X[s]
            end
            if not (C) then
                return false, "file not found"
            end
            local D, T = pcall(readfile, C)
            if if D then type(T) ~= "string" else not D then
                return false, "cannot read " .. tostring(C)
            end
            local D, n = loadstring(T, "=" .. s)
            if type(D) ~= "function" then
                K[s] = tostring(n)
                return false, K[s]
            end
            local T = {name = s, path = C, els = {}, secs = {}, tabs = {}, grows = {}, taps = {}, hks = {}, subs = {}, cs = {}, ths = {}, objs = {}, fns = {}, vis = {}, svis = {}}
            local C = E(T)
            n = setmetatable({sh = C, task = _(T), print = function(...)
                g(s, ...)
                print("[lua:" .. (s .. "]"), ...)
            end, warn = function(...)
                g(s, ...)
                warn("[lua:" .. (s .. "]"), ...)
            end}, {__index = v})
            T.sh = C
            T.env = n
            if type(setfenv) == "function" then
                pcall(setfenv, D, n)
            end
            K[s] = nil
            r[s] = T
            T.th = task.spawn(function()
                local n = table.pack(xpcall(D, function(D)
                    warn(debug.traceback("[lua:" .. (s .. ("] " .. tostring(D))), 2))
                    return tostring(D)
                end, C))
                T.th = nil
                if r[s] ~= T then
                    return
                end
                if not (n[1]) then
                    a(T, n[2])
                    d(s)
                    K[s] = n[2]
                    if W then
                        W:say(s .. (": " .. tostring(n[2])), c)
                    end
                    f.paint()
                    return
                end
                local C = n[2]
                if type(C) == "function" then
                    table.insert(T.fns, C)
                elseif type(C) == "table" then
                    if type(C.unload) == "function" then
                        table.insert(T.fns, C.unload)
                    end
                end
            end)
            if r[s] ~= T then
                return false, K[s] or "failed"
            end
            return true
        end
        f.halt = function(s)
            local C = d(s)
            f.paint()
            return C
        end
        local function s(C, D)
            if W then
                W:say(C, D)
            end
        end
        local function C(D, T)
            local n, x = f.boot(D)
            if n then
                g("lua", T .. (" " .. D))
                s(T .. (" " .. D), z.theme.text)
            else
                g("lua", D .. (": " .. tostring(x)))
                s(D .. (": " .. tostring(x)), c)
            end
            f.paint()
            return n
        end
        f.flip = function(D)
            if D then
                if r[D] then
                    d(D)
                    g("lua", "disabled " .. D)
                    s("disabled " .. D)
                    f.paint()
                else
                    C(D, "enabled")
                end
            else
                s("select a script first")
            end
        end
        f.redo = function(D)
            if not (D) then
                s("select a script first")
                return false
            end
            d(D)
            return C(D, "reloaded")
        end
        f.clear = function()
            for C in pairs(table.clone(r)) do
                d(C)
            end
            g("lua", "disabled all")
            s("disabled all")
            f.paint()
        end
        f.live = r
        f.fails = K
        f.logs = P
        f.rescan(true)
        N = L:tab({name = "lua", icon = "code", tip = "custom scripts"})
        W = N:files({name = "scripts", icon = "code", side = "left", height = 170, empty = "put .lua files into\nworkspace/shitarolua", list = function()
            local s = y
            return s
        end, state = function(s)
            return ((r[s] and "on") or (K[s] and "err")) or nil
        end, tap = f.flip, buttons = {{icon = "refresh-cw", tip = "reload selected", fn = f.redo}, {icon = "x", tip = "disable all", fn = f.clear}}})
        w = N:section({name = "console", side = "right"})
        B = w:label({name = "no output", wrap = true})
        w:button({name = "clear", icon = "trash-2", callback = function()
            table.clear(P)
            B:set("no output")
        end})
        task.spawn(function()
            while true do
                local s = b
                if not s then
                    break
                end
                task.wait(2)
                if b then
                    pcall(f.rescan)
                end
            end
        end)
        v.shitaro_lua = f
        v.LUA_UNLOAD = function()
            b = false
            for s in pairs(table.clone(r)) do
                pcall(d, s)
            end
            for s, s in pairs(u) do
                if s.on then
                    s.on = false
                    for C, C in ipairs(s.cs) do
                        pcall(function()
                            C:Disconnect()
                        end)
                    end
                    table.clear(s.cs)
                    if s.stop then
                        pcall(s.stop)
                    end
                end
            end
            z.spy = nil
            if v.shitaro_lua == f then
                v.shitaro_lua = nil
            end
        end
        return f
    end
    return F
end)()
end

                    mo.x = math.clamp(mo.x, 0.015, 0.985)
                end
                if (mo.y < 0.015) or (mo.y > 0.985) then
                    mo.vy = -mo.vy
                    mo.y = math.clamp(mo.y, 0.015, 0.985)
                end
                mo.px, mo.py = mo.x * Jo, mo.y * fo
                mo.hit = false
                for ao, Ho in next, Xo, nil do
                    if mo.px > Ho[1] then
                        if mo.px < Ho[3] then
                            if mo.py > Ho[2] then
                                if mo.py < Ho[4] then
                                    ao, go, wo, Po = mo.px - Ho[1], Ho[3] - mo.px, mo.py - Ho[2], Ho[4] - mo.py
                                    local Xo, to = math.min(ao, go, wo, Po), math.max(math.abs(mo.vx), math.abs(mo.vy), _o * 0.75)
                                    if (Xo == ao) and (Ho[1] > 4) then
                                        mo.vx = -to
                                    elseif (Xo == go) and (Ho[3] < (Jo - 4)) then
                                        mo.vx = to
                                    elseif (Xo == wo) and (Ho[2] > 4) then
                                        mo.vy = -to
                                    elseif (Xo == Po) and (Ho[4] < (fo - 4)) then
                                        mo.vy = to
                                    else
                                        mo.vx = ((mo.x < 0.5) and to) or -to
                                        mo.vy = ((mo.y < 0.5) and to) or -to
                                    end
                                    mo.hit = true
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if mo.hit then
                    mo.jam = mo.jam + Mo
                    if mo.jam > 2.5 then
                        mo.jam = 0
                        mo.x, mo.y = 0.2 + (math.random() * 0.6), 0.2 + (math.random() * 0.6)
                        mo.vx = (math.random() - 0.5) * _o
                        mo.vy = (math.random() - 0.5) * _o
                        mo.px, mo.py = mo.x * Jo, mo.y * fo
                        mo.hit = false
                    end
                else
                    mo.jam = 0
                end
                mo.o.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mo.px, mo.py)
                mo.o.BackgroundTransparency = mo.base + ((1 - mo.base) * Eo.veil)
            end
            for Xo = 1, yo, 1 do
                Jo, go = bo[Xo], Uo[Xo]
                for Po = Xo + 1, yo, 1 do
                    fo = bo[Po]
                    i(go[Po], Jo.px, Jo.py, fo.px, fo.py, Go)
                end
                Bo, Mo, wo = math.huge, 0, 0
                if Jo.hit then
                else
                    for yo, Po in next, uo, nil do
                        local _o, uo = Po[1] - Jo.px, Po[2] - Jo.py
                        yo = (_o * _o) + (uo * uo)
                        if yo < Bo then
                            Bo, Mo, wo = yo, Po[1], Po[2]
                        else
                        end
                    end
                end
                if Bo < math.huge then
                    i(Wo[Xo], Jo.px, Jo.py, Mo, wo, Go * 0.8)
                elseif Wo[Xo].Visible then
                    Wo[Xo].Visible = false
                end
            end
        end)
        Eo.mark = function(i, i)
            table.insert(Eo.marks, i)
        end
        return Eo
    end

    end

    local function yo(Po)
        local _o = table.create(#Po)
        for uo = 1, #Po, 1 do
            local wo = ((string.byte("sh1t4r0::cfg::v1", ((uo - 1) % 16) + 1) + (uo * 31)) + 91) % 256
            _o[uo] = string.char(bit32.bxor(string.byte(Po, uo), wo))
        end
        return table.concat(_o)
    end
    local function Po(_o)
        local uo, wo = {}, 1
        while wo <= #_o do
            local mo, Eo, bo = string.byte(_o, wo), string.byte(_o, wo + 1), string.byte(_o, wo + 2)
            local _o = ((mo * 65536) + ((Eo or 0) * 256)) + (bo or 0)
            mo = {math.floor(_o / 262144) % 64, math.floor(_o / 4096) % 64, math.floor(_o / 64) % 64, _o % 64}
            uo[#uo + 1] = string.sub("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/", mo[1] + 1, mo[1] + 1)
            uo[#uo + 1] = string.sub("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/", mo[2] + 1, mo[2] + 1)
            uo[#uo + 1] = (Eo and string.sub("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/", mo[3] + 1, mo[3] + 1)) or "="
            uo[#uo + 1] = (bo and string.sub("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/", mo[4] + 1, mo[4] + 1)) or "="
            wo += 3
        end
        return table.concat(uo)
    end
    local function _o(uo)
        uo = string.gsub(uo, "[^%w%+/=]", "")
        local wo, mo = {}, 1
        while mo < #uo do
            local Eo, bo = 0, 0
            for Uo = 0, 3, 1 do
                local Wo = string.sub(uo, mo + Uo, mo + Uo)
                if Wo == "=" then
                    local uo, Bo = Eo * 64, bo + 1
                    Eo, bo = uo, Bo
                else
                    Uo = nil
                    if Wo == "" then
                        Uo = Eo * 64
                        local uo = bo + 1
                        Eo, bo = Uo, uo
                    else
                        Uo = (Eo * 64) + (r[Wo] or 0)
                        Eo = Uo
                    end
                end
            end
            wo[#wo + 1] = string.char(math.floor(Eo / 65536) % 256)
            if bo < 2 then
                wo[#wo + 1] = string.char(math.floor(Eo / 256) % 256)
            end
            if bo < 1 then
                wo[#wo + 1] = string.char(Eo % 256)
            end
            mo += 4
        end
        return table.concat(wo)
    end
    local function r(uo)
        return (string.gsub(tostring(uo), "[%%\001\002\013\n]", function(uo)

        return (string.gsub(wo, "%%(%x%x)", function(wo)

                    Jo, Wo = (Q(Jo)), "c"

                        Jo, Wo = (Jo and "1") or "0", "b"

                        else
                            Wo = if type(Jo) == "string" then "s" else Wo
                        end
                    end
                end

                end

                Uo[#Uo + 1] = "t\001" .. (r(Wo) .. ("\001c\001" .. Q(Bo)))
            end

    end

        end

    local function s(y, Wo)
        if y.kind == "button" then
            return
        elseif type(y.item.set) ~= "function" then
            return
        end
        y.hold = true
        pcall(y.item.set, y.item, Wo, true)
        y.hold = false
    end
    local function y(Wo)
        return function(...)
            if Wo.hold then
                return
            end
            local Bo, fo = select("#", ...), {...}
            local Mo, Go, ao, Ho = fo[1], next, table.clone(Wo.pre)
            for to, to in Go, ao, Ho do
                local Yo, No = pcall(to, table.unpack(fo, 1, Bo))
                if Yo then
                    if No == false then
                        if Wo.last ~= nil then
                            s(Wo, Wo.last)
                        end
                        return
                    elseif No ~= nil then
                        if No ~= true then
                            fo[1] = No
                            Bo = math.max(Bo, 1)
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                    warn("[shitaroebet] " .. tostring(No))
                end
            end
            if fo[1] ~= Mo then
                s(Wo, fo[1])
            end
            Wo.last = fo[1]
            if Wo.cb then
                task.spawn(Wo.cb, table.unpack(fo, 1, Bo))
            end
            Ho, ao, Go = next, table.clone(Wo.post)
            for s, s in Ho, ao, Go do
                task.spawn(s, table.unpack(fo, 1, Bo))
            end
            Ho = K.spy
            if Ho then
                task.spawn(Ho, Wo, table.unpack(fo, 1, Bo))
            end
        end
    end
    local function s(Wo)
        if Wo then
            if Wo.dead then
                return
            end
        else
            return
        end
        Wo.dead = true
        for Bo = #Wo.kids, 1, -1 do
            s(Wo.kids[Bo])
        end
        local Bo = Wo.item
        pcall(function()
            if type(Bo.setopen) == "function" then
                Bo:setopen(false)
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if Bo.pod then
                Bo.pod:setopen(false)
            end
        end)
        if Wo.kind == "keybind" then
            if Bo.live then
                pcall(Co, nil)
            end
        end
        if Bo.sprig then
            G(Bo.sprig)
        end
        local fo = Wo.sec.seek.rows
        for Mo = #fo, 1, -1 do
            if fo[Mo].row == Bo.row then
                table.remove(fo, Mo)
            end
        end
        fo = table.find(Wo.sec.els, Wo)
        if fo then
            table.remove(Wo.sec.els, fo)
        end
        fo = table.find(K.els, Wo)
        if fo then
            table.remove(K.els, fo)
        end
        if Wo.up then
            fo = table.find(Wo.up.kids, Wo)
            if fo then
                table.remove(Wo.up.kids, fo)
            end
        end
        G(Wo.bag)
    end

                        elseif Cw ~= nil then
                            nw:set(Cw)
                            Cw = nil
                        end

                    end, press = function()
                        Lw.live = not Lw.live

                    end, state = function()

                    table.insert(wo.rows, {row = Uo, name = P.name})
                    local function Kw(Xw)
                        if P.multi then
                            return dw.tick[Xw] == true
                        end
                        return dw.pick == Xw
                    end
                    local function Xw()
                        local yw = {}
                        for Pw = 1, #P.list, 1 do
                            if dw.tick[P.list[Pw]] then
                                table.insert(yw, P.list[Pw])
                            end
                        end
                        return yw
                    end
                    local function yw(Pw, _w)
                        local uw, ww, mw = Kw(Pw.name), Pw.warm or (dw.leaf[rw] == Pw), (_w and b) or W
                        local Kw, Ew, bw = Pw.head, {}, (uw and 0.08) or ((ww and 0.4) or 1)
                        Ew.BackgroundTransparency = bw

                        _w, Ew = Pw.edge, {}
                        Ew.Transparency = (uw and 0.7) or 1
                        O(_w, mw, Ew)
                        _w, Ew = Pw.tint, {}
                        Ew.BackgroundTransparency = (uw and 0.86) or 1
                        O(_w, mw, Ew)

                        O(Pw.lbl, mw, {TextTransparency = (uw and 0) or ((ww and 0.15) or 0.45), TextColor3 = (uw and fo.text) or fo.dim})
                        if P.multi then
                            Kw, Ew = Pw.knob, {}
                            Ew.BackgroundTransparency = (uw and 0.05) or 1
                            O(Kw, mw, Ew)

                    local function Kw()
                        if not (P.multi) then
                            Lw.Text = dw.pick or "None"
                            return
                        end

                        Lw.Text = ((#Pw > 0) and table.concat(Pw, ", ")) or "None"
                    end
                    local function Lw()
                        O(zw, W, {BackgroundTransparency = ((dw.on or cw) and 0) or 0.12})

                        for Cw = 1, #dw.leaf, 1 do
                            yw(dw.leaf[Cw], true)
                        end

                        return (math.clamp(#dw.leaf, 1, bo) * 27) + 10
                    end
                    local function bo()
                        local vw = 0
                        for Pw = 1, #P.list, 1 do
                            local _w, uw = pcall(function()
                                local ww, mw, Ew = P.list[Pw], Enum.Font.GothamBold, table.pack(Vector2.new(4096, 24))
                                return z:GetTextSize(ww, 12, mw, unpackPacked(Ew))
                            end)
                            vw = if _w then if uw then math.max(vw, uw.X) else vw else vw
                        end
                        return math.ceil(vw) + ((P.multi and 56) or 52)
                    end
                    local function F()
                        local z, vw, Pw, _w = l(Oo), Z(Oo), l(zw), Z(zw)
                        local uw, ww = Pw.X - z.X, (dw.up and ((Pw.Y - z.Y) - 6)) or (((Pw.Y - z.Y) + _w.Y) + 6)
                        uw = if (uw + dw.w) > (vw.X - 8) then math.max(8, ((Pw.X - z.X) + _w.X) - dw.w) else uw
                        Aw.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(uw + 0.5), math.floor(ww + 0.5))
                        if xw then
                            xw.Position = Aw.Position
                        end
                    end

                        dw.h = Cw()
                        Aw.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(dw.w, dw.h)
                        if xw then
                            xw.Size = Aw.Size
                        end
                        F()
                    end
                    local function vw()
                        local Pw = Y(Aw)
                        local _w = (dw.on and 0) or 1
                        local uw = Dw.Rotation
                        local ww = (dw.on and 180) or 0
                        I(Aw, (dw.on and 0.34) or 0.26, (dw.on and k) or S, function(mw)
                            local Ew = Pw + ((_w - Pw) * mw)
                            N(Aw, Ew)
                            if xw then
                                xw.BackgroundTransparency = Ew
                                jw.Transparency = 0.35 + (0.65 * Ew)
                            end
                            if mw >= 1 then
                                Aw.Visible = dw.on
                                if xw then
                                    xw.Visible = dw.on
                                end
                            end
                        end)
                        I(Dw, 0.3, k, function(jw)
                            Dw.Rotation = uw + ((ww - uw) * jw)
                        end)

                    local function Dw(jw)
                        local Pw, _w, uw = X.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y / _, q(ew).Y + 12, table.find(dw.leaf, jw)
                        if uw then
                            if Pw <= 0 then
                                return
                            elseif _w <= Pw then
                                return
                            end
                        else
                            return
                        end
                        _w, jw = 6 + ((uw - 1) * 27), X.CanvasPosition.Y
                        if _w < jw then
                            X.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(_w - 6, 0))
                        elseif (_w + 25) > (jw + Pw) then
                            X.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, (_w + 31) - Pw)
                        end

                    local function jw(Pw)
                        local _w = dw.leaf[rw]
                        rw = Pw
                        if _w then
                            yw(_w, true)
                        end
                        _w = dw.leaf[rw]
                        if _w then
                            yw(_w, true)
                            Dw(_w)
                        end
                    end
                    local function Pw(_w)
                        if #dw.leaf == 0 then
                            return
                        end
                        local uw = rw + _w
                        jw(if uw < 1 then #dw.leaf else if uw > #dw.leaf then 1 else uw)
                        K:chime("tap")
                    end
                    local function jw(_w)
                        if not (_w) then
                            return
                        end
                        if P.multi then
                            local uw, ww, mw = dw.tick, _w.name, dw.tick[_w.name]
                            uw[ww] = if mw then nil else not mw
                            Jo()
                            K:chime((dw.tick[_w.name] and "on") or "off")
                            if P.callback then
                                task.spawn(P.callback, dw:get())
                            end
                            return
                        end
                        dw:set(_w.name)
                        dw:setopen(false)
                        K:chime("tap")
                    end
                    local function _w()

                            local ww = dw.leaf[uw]
                            for uw, uw in next, ww.cx, nil do

                                R(bw.knob, 4)

                                bw.nod = a("ImageLabel", {Name = B(), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = u("check"), ImageColor3 = fo.bg, ImageTransparency = 1, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, ZIndex = 34}, bw.knob)
                            else

                            table.insert(bw.cx, bw.btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                                local uw = dw.leaf[rw]
                                bw.warm = true
                                rw = 0
                                if uw then
                                    if uw ~= bw then
                                        yw(uw, true)
                                    end
                                end
                                yw(bw, true)
                            end))
                            table.insert(bw.cx, bw.btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                                bw.warm = false
                                yw(bw, true)
                            end))
                            table.insert(bw.cx, bw.btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

                            end))

                            yw(bw, true)

                    local uw, ww
                    local function mw()
                        if uw then
                            uw:Disconnect()
                            uw = nil
                        end
                    end
                    local function Ew()
                        if ww then
                            ww:Disconnect()
                            ww = nil
                        end
                    end
                    local function bw()
                        dw:setopen(false)
                    end
                    local function Uw()
                        if Do > 0 then
                            F()
                            return
                        end
                        if ao.open then
                            if io.Visible then
                                if not (Uo.Visible) then
                                    bw()
                                    return
                                end
                            else
                                bw()
                                return
                            end
                        else
                            bw()
                            return
                        end
                        local Uo, Ww, Bw, Jw, fw, Mw = U.AbsolutePosition, U.AbsoluteSize, uo.AbsolutePosition, uo.AbsoluteSize, zw.AbsolutePosition, zw.AbsoluteSize
                        local U = fw.Y + (Mw.Y * 0.5)
                        if U < Uo.Y then
                            bw()
                            return
                        elseif U > (Uo.Y + Ww.Y) then
                            bw()
                            return
                        elseif U < Bw.Y then
                            bw()
                            return
                        elseif U > (Bw.Y + Jw.Y) then
                            bw()
                            return
                        end
                        F()
                    end
                    local function F(U)
                        if K.capturing then
                            return
                        elseif U.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
                            return
                        end
                        local uo = U.KeyCode
                        if uo == Enum.KeyCode.Down then
                            Pw(1)
                        elseif uo == Enum.KeyCode.Up then
                            Pw(-1)
                        elseif (uo == Enum.KeyCode.Return) or (uo == Enum.KeyCode.KeypadEnter) then
                            jw(dw.leaf[rw])
                        elseif uo == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
                            bw()
                        end
                    end
                    dw.setopen = function(U, U)
                        U = (U and true) or false
                        if dw.on == U then
                            return
                        end
                        dw.on = U
                        if U then
                            eo()
                            local U, uo, Uo, jw = l(Oo), Z(Oo), l(zw), Z(zw)
                            dw.w = math.clamp(math.max(bo(), math.floor(jw.X + 0.5)), 130, math.max(math.floor(uo.X) - 16, 130))
                            dw.h = Cw()
                            local bo, zw = (uo.Y - (((Uo.Y - U.Y) + jw.Y) + 6)) - 6, (Uo.Y - U.Y) - 12
                            dw.up = (bo < dw.h) and (zw > bo)
                            Aw.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, (dw.up and 1) or 0)

                            nw.Visible = true
                            X.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new()

                                xw.AnchorPoint = Aw.AnchorPoint
                                xw.Visible = true

                                for U = 1, jw, 1 do
                                    if dw.leaf[U].name == dw.pick then
                                        rw = U
                                        yw(dw.leaf[U], true)
                                        Dw(dw.leaf[U])
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            mw()
                            Ew()

                            ww = C.InputBegan:Connect(F)
                        else
                            mw()
                            Ew()

                            rw = 0
                            if no == bw then
                                no, xo = nil, nil
                            end
                            for F = 1, #dw.leaf, 1 do
                                dw.leaf[F].warm = false
                                yw(dw.leaf[F], true)
                            end

                        vw()

                    dw.get = function(F)
                        if not (P.multi) then
                            return dw.pick
                        end
                        return Xw()
                    end
                    dw.set = function(F, U, uo)
                        if P.multi then
                            F = {}
                            if type(U) == "table" then
                                for bo, bo in next, U, nil do
                                    F[bo] = true
                                end
                            elseif type(U) == "string" then
                                for bo in string.gmatch(U, "[^,]+") do
                                    F[string.match(bo, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")] = true
                                end
                            else
                                return
                            end
                            table.clear(dw.tick)
                            for bo = 1, #P.list, 1 do
                                if F[P.list[bo]] then
                                    dw.tick[P.list[bo]] = true
                                end
                            end
                            Jo()
                            if not (uo) then
                                if P.callback then
                                    task.spawn(P.callback, dw:get())
                                end
                            end
                            return
                        end
                        if type(U) ~= "string" then
                            return
                        elseif U == dw.pick then
                            return
                        elseif not (table.find(P.list, U)) then
                            return
                        end
                        dw.pick = U
                        Jo()
                        if not (uo) then
                            if P.callback then
                                task.spawn(P.callback, U)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    dw.setlist = function(F, U)
                        if type(U) ~= "table" then
                            return
                        end
                        F = (P.multi and dw:get()) or dw.pick
                        P.list = U
                        dw.pick = nil
                        table.clear(dw.tick)
                        _w()
                        if P.multi then
                            dw:set(F, true)
                        elseif F and table.find(U, F) then
                            dw:set(F, true)
                        else
                            dw:set(U[1], true)
                        end
                        Kw()
                        if not (dw.on) then
                            return
                        end
                        if #U == 0 then
                            bw()
                            return
                        end
                        z()
                    end
                    H(ew:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"), function()
                        X.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, q(ew).Y + 12)
                    end)
                    H(nw.MouseButton1Click, bw)
                    H(Tw.MouseButton1Click, function()
                        if #P.list == 0 then

                        end
                        dw:setopen(not dw.on)
                        K:chime("flip")
                    end)

                        cw = true
                        Lw()
                    end)
                    H(Tw.MouseLeave, function()
                        cw = false
                        Lw()
                    end)
                    _w()
                    if P.multi then
                        if P.default ~= nil then
                            dw:set(P.default)
                        end
                    else
                        dw:set(P.default or P.list[1])
                    end
                    Kw()
                    Lw()
                    K:hook(P.flag or (mo .. ("|" .. P.name)), "list", function()
                        if P.multi then
                            return table.concat(dw:get(), ", ")
                        end
                        return dw.pick
                    end, function(F)
                        dw:set(F)
                    end)
                    return dw
                end
                go.button = function(F, z)
                    local X = i(z, {name = "button", icon = nil, flag = nil, callback = nil})

                    R(uo, 6)
                    local bo = a("UIStroke", {Color = fo.line, Transparency = 0.62}, uo)
                    local Uo = a("Frame", {Name = B(), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = fo.accent, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 6}, uo)
                    R(Uo, 6)
                    so(Uo, 0, {NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, 0.62), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
                    local Jo = (X.icon and a("ImageLabel", {Name = B(), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 9, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 13), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = u(X.icon), ImageColor3 = fo.dim, ImageTransparency = 0.25, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, ZIndex = 7}, uo)) or nil
                    local zw = a("TextLabel", {Name = B(), Position = UDim2.fromOffset((X.icon and 27) or 9, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, (X.icon and -36) or -18, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Text = X.name, TextColor3 = fo.dim, TextSize = 13, TextTransparency = 0.25, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextXAlignment = (X.icon and Enum.TextXAlignment.Left) or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 7}, uo)
                    local Cw = a("Frame", {Name = B(), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = fo.accent, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 8}, uo)
                    so(Cw, 0, {NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})

                        O(bo, W, {Transparency = (vw and 0.4) or 0.62})

                            O(Jo, W, {ImageTransparency = (vw and 0) or 0.25, ImageColor3 = (vw and fo.text) or fo.dim})

                    end
                    Lw.fire = function(uo)
                        Uo.BackgroundTransparency = 0.72
                        Cw.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
                        O(Uo, W, {BackgroundTransparency = (vw and 0.88) or 1})

                    local Aw, ew, dw, cw, rw, Kw = (xw and 0.1) or ((y and 0.45) or 1), (xw and 0.35) or ((y and 0.6) or 1), (xw and fo.accent) or fo.line, (xw and 0) or ((y and 0.12) or 0.4), (xw and fo.text) or fo.dim, (xw and 0) or ((y and 0.06) or 0.22)
                    Tw.mark.Visible = xw
                    if nw then
                        Tw.head.BackgroundTransparency = jw
                        Tw.tint.BackgroundTransparency = Aw
                        Tw.edge.Transparency = ew
                        Tw.edge.Color = dw
                        Tw.lbl.TextTransparency = cw
                        Tw.lbl.TextColor3 = rw
                        Tw.shot.ImageTransparency = Kw
                        return
                    end
                    O(Tw.head, W, {BackgroundTransparency = jw})
                    O(Tw.tint, W, {BackgroundTransparency = Aw})
                    O(Tw.edge, W, {Transparency = ew, Color = dw})
                    O(Tw.lbl, W, {TextTransparency = cw, TextColor3 = rw})
                    O(Tw.shot, W, {ImageTransparency = Kw})
                end
                local function y(Tw)
                    if not (Tw.name) then
                        return
                    end
                    K:chime("tap")
                    if n.multi then
                        if eo[Tw.name] then
                            eo[Tw.name] = nil
                        else
                            eo[Tw.name] = true
                        end
                    else
                        local nw = jo
                        jo = if nw == Tw.name then if n.reset then nil else Tw.name else Tw.name
                    end
                    Tw = Po
                    for nw = 1, Tw, 1 do
                        Dw(ro[nw])
                    end
                    vw()
                    Lw()
                end

                            nw.skip = nil
                            return

                        y(nw)
                    end)
                    if type(n.context) == "function" then

                            if not (nw.name) then
                                return
                            end

                local function y(nw)
                    nw.head.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Uo, Jo)
                    nw.shot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Uo - 8, Uo - 8)
                    nw.lbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, Uo - 3)
