        local function i()
            local environment518, no = getfenv(), uo()
            if no ~= Ao.s then
                Ao.s, Ao.at, Ao.fresh = no, environment518.os.clock(), no ~= nil
                Ao.url = (no and no.SoundId) or ""
                Ao.on = ((no ~= nil) and no.IsPlaying) and (Ao.url ~= "")
                eo()
                return
            end
            if not (no) then
                return
            end
            if Ao.fresh then
                if (environment518.os.clock() - Ao.at) > 0.5 then
                    Ao.fresh = false
                    if k.on then
                        if zo then
                            local Lo = zo
                            if Lo.radio then
                                if bo() then
                                    local Lo, xo = no.SoundId, zo
                                    if Lo ~= xo.url then
                                        local Lo = zo
                                        Lo.own = true
                                        Lo = zo
                                        wo(Lo.url)
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local Lo = no.SoundId
            local xo = no.IsPlaying and (Lo ~= "")
            if Lo == Ao.url then
                if xo == Ao.on then
                    return
                end
            end
            Ao.url, Ao.on = Lo, xo
            if mo(Lo) then
                return
            elseif not (k.on) then
                return
            end
            local jo = Ko(Lo)
            if xo and jo then
                local xo, yo = zo
                if xo then
                    local Po = zo
                    yo = Po.radio
                else
                    yo = xo
                end
                xo = nil
                if yo then
                    local Po = zo
                    xo = Po.url == Lo
                else
                    xo = yo
                end
                if not (xo and (bo())) then
                    local xo, yo = I[jo] or {id = jo}, {radio = true, quiet = true}
                    yo.at = no.TimePosition
                    Go(xo, yo)
                end
            elseif zo then
                local no = zo
                if no.radio then
                    if bo() then
                        if Lo == "" then
                            p(false)
                        else
                            local no = zo
                            if Lo == no.url then
                                p(false)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local function p()
            local environment519, no = getfenv(), Ao.s
            if zo then
                local xo = zo
                if xo.radio then
                    local xo = zo
                    if xo.state == "playing" then
                        if no then
                            if no.Parent then
                                local xo, jo = no.SoundId, zo
                                if not (xo == jo.url) then
                                    return
                                end
                            else
                                return
                            end
                        else
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
            else
                return
            end
            if no.IsPlaying then
                if no.IsLoaded then
                    if Eo.IsLoaded then
                        if not (Eo.IsPlaying) then
                            return
                        end
                    else
                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
            else
                return
            end
            local xo, jo, Ao = Eo.TimePosition, no.TimePosition, Eo.TimeLength
            if Ao <= 0 then
                return
            elseif environment519.math.abs(xo - jo) <= 0.3 then
                return
            end
            if xo > (Ao - 1.5) then
                if jo < 1.5 then
                    return
                elseif jo > (Ao - 1.5) then
                    if xo < 1.5 then
                        return
                    end
                end
            elseif jo > (Ao - 1.5) then
                if xo < 1.5 then
                    return
                end
            end
            Eo.TimePosition = jo
        end

        local function Bo(fo, to)

            for Vo = 1, #R, 1 do
                local So = R[Vo]
                Vo = fo.Files[So.File]
                local Io = Vo and to:FindFirstChild(So.Part)
                if Io then
                    local Ro = "BasePart"
                    if Io:IsA(Ro) then
                        local Ro = eo(Vo)
                        if Ro then
                            for Vo, Qo in environment586.ipairs(to:GetChildren()) do
                                Vo = "CharacterMesh"
                                if Qo:IsA(Vo) then
                                    if Qo.BodyPart == So.Body then
                                        yo(Qo)
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            for Vo, Qo in environment586.ipairs(Io:GetChildren()) do
                                Vo = "SpecialMesh"
                                if Qo:IsA(Vo) then
                                    yo(Qo)
                                end
                            end
                            local Vo, Qo = #Uo + 1, {Obj = Io}
                            Qo.Val, Uo[Vo] = Io.Color, Qo
                            Io.Color = environment586.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                            Vo = environment586.Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
                            Vo.MeshType = environment586.Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
                            Vo.MeshId = Ro
                            Vo.Scale = environment586.Vector3.one
                            Vo.VertexColor = environment586.Vector3.one
                            Vo.Parent = Io
                            Wo[#Wo + 1] = Vo
                            Jo[So.Body] = true
                            ho += 1
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if ho > 0 then
                for Uo, Jo in environment586.ipairs(to:GetChildren()) do
                    fo = "Shirt"
                    if Jo:IsA(fo) then
                        yo(Jo)
                    else
                        Uo = "Pants"
                        if Jo:IsA(Uo) then
                            yo(Jo)
                        else
                            local Uo = "ShirtGraphic"
                            if Jo:IsA(Uo) then
                                yo(Jo)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return ho
        end
        local function yo(Uo)
            local environment587 = getfenv()
            for fo, fo in environment587.ipairs(Uo:GetDescendants()) do
                if (((fo:IsA("JointInstance") or fo:IsA("Constraint")) or fo:IsA("BodyMover")) or fo:IsA("LuaSourceContainer")) or fo:IsA("Humanoid") then
                    environment587.pcall(function()
                        fo:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
        local function Uo(Jo)
            Jo.Anchored = false
            Jo.CanCollide = false
            Jo.CanQuery = false
            Jo.CanTouch = false
            Jo.Massless = true
            Jo.Locked = true
            Jo.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
        end
        local function Jo(fo)
            local environment588, Yo = getfenv(), {}
            for ho, ho in environment588.ipairs(fo:GetDescendants()) do
                if ho:IsA("BasePart") or ho:IsA("Decal") then
                    local fo, Vo = #Yo + 1, {Obj = ho}
                    Vo.Val, Yo[fo] = ho.Transparency, Vo
                    environment588.pcall(function()
                        ho.Transparency = 1
                    end)
                end
            end
            return Yo
        end
        local function fo(to, Yo, ho, Vo, So)
            local environment589 = getfenv()
            if Mo[to] then
                return true
            end
            local Ro = to:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            Ro = if Ro then if Ro:IsA("BasePart") then Ro else to:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") else to:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if not (Ro) then
                return false
            end
            local Qo = {}
            if ((Yo and ho) and Vo) and Vo.Parent then
                if (Ro.Position - Vo.Position).Magnitude > 6 then
                    return false
                end
                local Fw, sw, zw = ((So or Co) * Vo.CFrame:Inverse()) * Ro.CFrame, Ro.CFrame:Inverse(), {}
                for Vo, So in environment589.ipairs(to:GetDescendants()) do
                    Vo = "BasePart"
                    if So:IsA(Vo) then
                        zw[#zw + 1] = So
                    end
                end
                local Vo = to:Clone()
                yo(Vo)
                local So = {}
                for Ro, Cw in environment589.ipairs(Vo:GetDescendants()) do
                    Ro = "BasePart"
                    if Cw:IsA(Ro) then
                        So[#So + 1] = Cw
                    end
                end
                for Ro = 1, #So, 1 do
                    local Cw, Lw = zw[Ro], So[Ro]
                    if Cw then
                        Ro = Fw * (sw * Cw.CFrame)
                        Uo(Lw)
                        Lw.CastShadow = false
                        Lw.Parent = Yo
                        Lw.CFrame = ho.CFrame * Ro
                        local Yo = environment589.Instance.new("Weld")
                        Yo.Part0 = ho
                        Yo.Part1 = Lw
                        Yo.C0 = Ro
                        Yo.Parent = Lw
                        Qo[#Qo + 1] = Lw
                    end
                end
                environment589.pcall(function()
                    Vo:Destroy()
                end)
                if #Qo == 0 then
                    return false
                end
            end
            Mo[to] = {Parts = Qo, Hidden = Jo(to)}
            return true
        end
        local function Jo(Mo)
            bo(Mo.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(to)
                if not (uo) then
                    return
                end
                Xo(to, Mo)
            end))
        end
        local function Xo(Mo, to, Yo, ho)
            local environment590 = getfenv()
            local So, Io
            if to then
                So = Mo:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or Mo:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
                if So then
                    local Ro = "BasePart"
                    if So:IsA(Ro) then
                    else
                        local Ro
                        So = Ro
                    end
                else
                end
                Io = So
            else
                Io = So
            end
            local function So(Ro)
                local environment591 = getfenv()
                environment591.task.defer(function()
                    local Qo, Fw, sw = 1, 12, 1
                    for zw = Qo, Fw, sw do
                        if uo then
                            if Ro.Parent ~= Mo then
                                return
                            end
                        else
                            return
                        end
                        if fo(Ro, to, Yo, Io, ho) then
                            return
                        end
                        RunService16.RenderStepped:Wait()
                    end
                end)
            end
            for fo, to in environment590.ipairs(Mo:GetChildren()) do
                fo = "Tool"
                if to:IsA(fo) then
                    So(to)
                end
            end
            bo(Mo.ChildAdded:Connect(function(fo)
                if uo then
                    local to = "Tool"
                    if fo:IsA(to) then
                        So(fo)
                    end
                end
            end))
            bo(Mo.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(fo)
                local Mo = "Tool"
                if fo:IsA(Mo) then
                    Oo(fo)
                end
            end))
        end
        local function fo(Mo, to)
            local environment592, Oo = getfenv(), {Mo}
            for ho, ho in environment592.ipairs(Mo:GetDescendants()) do
                Oo[#Oo + 1] = ho
            end
            for ho = 1, #Oo, 1 do
                local Vo = Oo[ho]
                if Vo:IsA("BasePart") or Vo:IsA("Decal") then
                    ho, Mo = #to + 1, {Obj = Vo, Key = "Transparency"}
                    Mo.Val, to[ho] = Vo.Transparency, Mo
                    environment592.pcall(function()
                        Vo.Transparency = 1
                    end)
                elseif (((((Vo:IsA("Beam") or Vo:IsA("ParticleEmitter")) or Vo:IsA("Trail")) or Vo:IsA("Fire")) or Vo:IsA("Smoke")) or Vo:IsA("Sparkles")) or Vo:IsA("Light") then
                    local Mo, Oo = #to + 1, {Obj = Vo, Key = "Enabled"}
                    Oo.Val, to[Mo] = Vo.Enabled, Oo
                    environment592.pcall(function()
                        Vo.Enabled = false
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
        local function Mo(to, Yo, Oo, ho)
            local environment593, So = getfenv(), to:Clone()
            yo(So)
            for to, Io in environment593.ipairs(So:GetDescendants()) do
                to = "BasePart"
                if Io:IsA(to) then
                    Uo(Io)
                    Io.CastShadow = false
                end
            end
            Uo(So)
            So.CastShadow = false
            So.Parent = Yo
            So.CFrame = Oo.CFrame * ho
            Yo = environment593.Instance.new("Weld")
            Yo.Part0 = Oo
            Yo.Part1 = So
            Yo.C0 = ho
            Yo.Parent = So
            return So
        end
        local function to(Yo, Oo, ho)
            local Vo, So = Yo:FindFirstChild(ho), Oo:FindFirstChild(ho)
            if Vo then
                if So then
                    Oo = "Attachment"
                    if Vo:IsA(Oo) then
                        ho = "Attachment"
                        if So:IsA(ho) then
                            return Vo.CFrame * So.CFrame:Inverse()
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function Yo(Oo, ho)
            local environment594, So = getfenv(), Oo:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if So then
                if not (ho) then
                    return nil
                end
            else
                return nil
            end
            if ho == So then
                return environment594.CFrame.new()
            end
            local Vo = Oo:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
            if not (Vo) then
                return nil
            end
            local Io = to(So, Vo, "RootRigAttachment")
            if not (Io) then
                return nil
            end
            if ho == Vo then
                return Io
            end
            if ho == Oo:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") then
                So = to(Vo, ho, "WaistRigAttachment")
                if So then
                    return Io * So
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function to(Oo)
            local ho = Oo:FindFirstChildOfClass("RigidConstraint")
            if ho then
                return ho.Attachment0, ho.Attachment1
            end
            return nil, nil
        end
        local function Oo(ho, Vo, So, Io)
            if So then
                if Io then
                    if So.Parent then
                        local Ro, Qo = So.Parent, "BasePart"
                        if Ro:IsA(Qo) then
                            if So.Parent.Parent == ho then
                                local Ro = Yo(ho, So.Parent)
                                if Ro then
                                    return (Ro * So.CFrame) * Io.CFrame:Inverse()
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            Io = ho:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if Io then
                return Io.CFrame:Inverse() * Vo.CFrame
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function Yo(ho, Vo, So, Io)
            local environment595 = getfenv()
            for Qo = 1, #Go, 1 do
                if Go[Qo].Obj == Io then
                    return
                end
            end
            local Qo, Fw = to(Io)
            local sw = {Obj = Io, Hidden = {}, Clone = nil, Host = Qo}
            if Vo then
                if So then
                    if So.Parent then
                        local zw = Oo(ho, Io, Qo, Fw)
                        if zw then
                            local Oo, ho = environment595.pcall(Mo, Io, Vo, So, zw)
                            if Oo then
                                sw.Clone = ho
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            fo(Io, sw.Hidden)
            Go[#Go + 1] = sw
        end
        local function fo(Mo, Oo, ho)
            local environment596 = getfenv()
            if uo then
                if Mo then
                    if not (Mo.Parent) then
                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
            else
                return
            end
            local So = {}
            for Io = 1, #Q, 1 do
                local Ro = Mo:FindFirstChild(Q[Io])
                Io = (Ro and Ro:IsA("ObjectValue")) and Ro.Value
                if Io then
                    Ro = "BasePart"
                    if Io:IsA(Ro) then
                        if Io.Parent then
                            So[Io] = true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for Io = #Go, 1, -1 do
                local Ro = Go[Io]
                local Qo = So[Ro.Obj]
                local Fw = if Qo then not Ro.Obj.Parent else not Qo
                if Fw then
                else
                    if Ro.Clone then
                        local Qo, sw = to(Ro.Obj), Ro.Clone.Parent
                        Fw = if sw then Ro.Host ~= Qo else not sw
                    else
                    end
                end
                if Fw then
                    oo(Ro)
                    environment596.table.remove(Go, Io)
                end
            end
            for Go in environment596.pairs(So) do
                Yo(Mo, Oo, ho, Go)
            end
        end
        local function Mo(Go, to, Yo)
            local function Oo(ho)
                if ho then
                    local oo = "ObjectValue"
                    if not (ho:IsA(oo)) then
                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
                bo(ho.Changed:Connect(function()
                    local environment597 = getfenv()
                    if not (uo) then
                        return
                    end
                    environment597.task.defer(function()
                        fo(Go, to, Yo)
                    end)
                end))
            end
            for ho = 1, #Q, 1 do
                Oo(Go:FindFirstChild(Q[ho]))
            end
            bo(Go.ChildAdded:Connect(function(Q)
                local environment598 = getfenv()
                if not (uo) then
                    return
                end
                if Q.Name ~= "DisplayRefKnife" then
                    if Q.Name ~= "DisplayRefGun" then
                        return
                    end
                end
                Oo(Q)
                environment598.task.defer(function()
                    fo(Go, to, Yo)
                end)
            end))
            fo(Go, to, Yo)
        end
        local function Q(Go, to)
            local function Yo()
                local environment599 = getfenv()
                if uo then
                    if go then
                        return
                    end
                else
                    return
                end
                go = true
                local ho = No
                environment599.task.defer(function()
                    go = false
                    if uo then
                        if ho == No then
                            io()
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            if to then
                bo(to.Died:Connect(Yo))
                bo(to:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Health"):Connect(function()
                    if to.Health <= 0 then
                        Yo()
                    end
                end))
            end
            bo(Go.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
                local environment600 = getfenv()
                local to = environment600.workspace
                if not (Go:IsDescendantOf(to)) then
                    Yo()
                end
            end))
            bo(r.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(bo)
                if bo == Go then
                    Yo()
                end
            end))
        end
        local function bo(Go, go, to)
            local environment601, Oo = getfenv(), go:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not (Oo) then
                return 0
            end
            local ho, oo = {}, 0
            for Vo = 1, #R, 1 do
                local So = R[Vo]
                Vo = Go.Files[So.File]
                if Vo then
                    local R = eo(Vo)
                    if R then
                        ho[So.Part] = R
                        oo += 1
                    else
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            if oo == 0 then
                return 0
            end
            local R = environment601.Instance.new("Model")
            R.Name = "SHITARO_R6"
            local eo = {}
            for Vo = 1, #Lo, 1 do
                local So, Io = Lo[Vo], environment601.Instance.new("Part")
                Io.Name = So.Name
                Io.Size = So.Size
                Io.TopSurface = environment601.Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
                Io.BottomSurface = environment601.Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
                Io.CFrame = Oo.CFrame
                Uo(Io)
                if So.Name == "Root" then
                    Io.Anchored = true
                    Io.Transparency = 1
                end
                Go = ho[So.Name]
                if Go then
                    Io.Color = environment601.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                    Vo = environment601.Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
                    Vo.MeshType = environment601.Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
                    Vo.MeshId = Go
                    Vo.Scale = environment601.Vector3.one
                    Vo.VertexColor = environment601.Vector3.one
                    Vo.Parent = Io
                end
                Io.Parent = R
                eo[So.Name] = Io
            end
            for Lo, Vo in environment601.pairs(Do) do
                local Do = environment601.Instance.new("Attachment")
                Do.Name = Lo
                Do.Position = Vo
                Do.Parent = eo.Torso
            end
            Go = go:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local Lo
            if Go and Go:IsA("BasePart") then
                Lo = Go:Clone()
                yo(Lo)
                Lo.Name = "Head"
                Uo(Lo)
            else
                Lo = environment601.Instance.new("Part")
                Lo.Name = "Head"
                Lo.Size = environment601.Vector3.new(2, 1, 1)
                Uo(Lo)
                local Do = environment601.Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
                Do.MeshType = environment601.Enum.MeshType.Head
                Do.Scale = environment601.Vector3.new(1.25, 1.25, 1.25)
                Do.Parent = Lo
            end
            Lo.CFrame = Oo.CFrame * environment601.CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0)
            Lo.Parent = R
            eo.Head = Lo
            Oo = Lo:FindFirstChild("NeckRigAttachment")
            Go = environment601.CFrame.new((Oo and Oo.Position) or environment601.Vector3.new(0, -Lo.Size.Y * 0.5, 0)) * Fo
            for Fo = 1, #vo, 1 do
                Oo = vo[Fo]
                local Lo, vo = eo[Oo.Part0], eo[Oo.Part1]
                if Lo then
                    if vo then
                        Fo = environment601.Instance.new("Motor6D")
                        Fo.Name = Oo.Name
                        Fo.Part0 = Lo
                        Fo.Part1 = vo
                        Fo.C0 = Oo.C0
                        Fo.C1 = ((Oo.Name == "Neck") and Go) or Oo.C1
                        Fo.Parent = eo[Oo.Holder]
                    end
                end
            end
            Go = environment601.Instance.new("AnimationController")
            Go.Parent = R
            local Fo = environment601.Instance.new("Animator")
            Fo.Parent = Go
            R.PrimaryPart = eo.Root
            R.Parent = environment601.workspace.CurrentCamera or environment601.workspace
            Wo[#Wo + 1] = R
            environment601._G.FAKE_MODEL_RIG = R
            local Lo = go:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyColors")
            local vo, Do, Vo = 1, #so, 1
            for So = vo, Do, Vo do
                local Io = so[So]
                Go = eo[Io.Part]
                if Go and not ho[Io.Part] then
                    local so
                    if Lo then
                        environment601.pcall(function()
                            so = Lo[Io.Field]
                        end)
                    end
                    if not so then
                        Oo = go:FindFirstChild(Io.Source)
                        if Oo and Oo:IsA("BasePart") then
                            so = Oo.Color
                        else
                        end
                    else
                    end
                    if so then
                        Go.Color = so
                    end
                end
            end
            ho = {}
            for so, so in environment601.pairs(eo) do
                for Lo, Lo in environment601.ipairs(so:GetChildren()) do
                    Oo = "Attachment"
                    if Lo:IsA(Oo) then
                        ho[Lo.Name] = Lo
                    end
                end
            end
            for so, Lo in environment601.ipairs(go:GetChildren()) do
                Oo = "Accoutrement"
                if Lo:IsA(Oo) then
                    Vo = Lo:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                    so = Vo and Vo:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Attachment")
                    Do = so and ho[so.Name]
                    if Do then
                        vo = Vo:Clone()
                        yo(vo)
                        Uo(vo)
                        Go = Do.CFrame * so.CFrame:Inverse()
                        vo.CFrame = Do.Parent.CFrame * Go
                        vo.Parent = R
                        local so = environment601.Instance.new("Weld")
                        so.Part0 = Do.Parent
                        so.Part1 = vo
                        so.C0 = Go
                        so.Parent = vo
                    end
                end
            end
            co(go)
            Jo(go)
            Xo(go, R, eo["Right Arm"])
            Mo(go, R, eo.Torso)
            Q(go, to)
            local so = {}
            for Lo, vo in environment601.pairs(To) do
                local Do = environment601.Instance.new("Animation")
                Do.Name = Lo
                Do.AnimationId = vo
                Do.Parent = R
                Go, Vo = environment601.pcall(function()
                    return Fo:LoadAnimation(Do)
                end)
                if Go then
                    if Vo then
                        so[Lo] = Vo
                    end
                end
            end
            local Fo, Lo
            local function vo(Do, To)
                local environment602, Go = getfenv(), so[Do]
                if Fo ~= Do then
                    for Yo, Oo in environment602.pairs(so) do
                        if Yo ~= Do then
                            if Oo.IsPlaying then
                                environment602.pcall(function()
                                    Oo:Stop(0.15)
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if Go then
                        environment602.pcall(function()
                            Go:Play(0.15)
                        end)
                    end
                    Fo, Lo = Do, nil
                end
                if Go and To then
                    if To ~= Lo then
                        Lo = To
                        environment602.pcall(function()
                            Go:AdjustSpeed(To)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
            local Fo = eo.Root
            local so = 0
            Ho = RunService16.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                local environment603 = getfenv()
                if not (uo) then
                    return
                end
                if R.Parent == nil then
                    environment603.pcall(function()
                        local environment604 = getfenv()
                        R.Parent = environment604.workspace.CurrentCamera or environment604.workspace
                    end)
                end
                if (environment603.os.clock() - so) > 0.5 then
                    so = environment603.os.clock()
                    fo(r.Character, R, eo.Torso)
                end
                if r.Character == go then
                    if go.Parent then
                        if R.Parent then
                            local R = go:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            if R then
                                local so = R.CFrame
                                local Do = so.Position
                                local To = (Do.Y - (R.Size.Y * 0.5)) - ((to and to.HipHeight) or 0)
                                Fo.CFrame = environment603.CFrame.new(Do.X, To + 3, Do.Z) * so.Rotation
                                so, Do = to and (to:GetState()), R.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                                To = environment603.math.sqrt((Do.X * Do.X) + (Do.Z * Do.Z))
                                if so == environment603.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
                                    vo("jump")
                                elseif so == environment603.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
                                    vo("fall")
                                elseif so == environment603.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing then
                                    vo("climb", 1)
                                elseif so == environment603.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated then
                                    vo("sit")
                                elseif To > 0.75 then
                                    vo("walk", environment603.math.floor(environment603.math.clamp(To / 14.5, 0.4, 3) * 20) / 20)
                                else
                                    vo("idle")
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            return oo
        end
        local function R(Fo)
            local environment605, Lo = getfenv(), r.Character
            if not (Lo) then
                u:Notify({Title = "SHITARO", Content = "Model Changer: no character", Duration = 4, Icon = "person"})
                return
            end
            if (environment605["type"](environment605.makefolder) == "function") and (environment605["type"](environment605.isfolder) == "function") then
                local vo = false
                environment605.pcall(function()
                    local environment606 = getfenv()
                    vo = environment606.isfolder("shitaro_bodies")
                end)
                if not vo then
                    environment605.pcall(environment605.makefolder, "shitaro_bodies")
                end
            end
            local vo = Lo:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local Do, To = (Lo:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") ~= nil) or (vo and (vo.RigType == environment605.Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15))
            if Do then
                To = (bo(Fo, Lo, vo))
            else
                To = Bo(Fo, Lo)
                if To > 0 then
                    Ao(Lo)
                end
            end
            if To == 0 then
                u:Notify({Title = "SHITARO", Content = "Model Changer: " .. (((Do and "R15") or "R6") .. ", 0 meshes loaded"), Duration = 4, Icon = "person"})
            end
        end
        local function Fo(so)
            local environment607, vo = getfenv(), mo[so.Name]
            if vo then
                return vo
            end
            vo = so.Id
            if not vo then
                return nil
            end
            local Do, To = environment607.pcall(environment607.game.GetObjects, environment607.game, "rbxassetid://" .. vo)
            if Do then
                if environment607["type"](To) ~= "table" then
                    return nil
                end
            else
                return nil
            end
            local vo = To[1]
            if not (vo) then
                return nil
            end
            local Ao, eo = "Model"
            if vo:IsA(Ao) then
                eo = vo
            else
                Do = environment607.Instance.new("Model")
                vo.Parent = Do
                eo = Do
            end
            for vo, vo in environment607.ipairs(eo:GetDescendants()) do
                if (((vo:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or vo:IsA("Humanoid")) or vo:IsA("JointInstance")) or vo:IsA("Constraint")) or vo:IsA("BodyMover") then
                    environment607.pcall(function()
                        vo:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end
            Do = false
            for vo, vo in environment607.ipairs(eo:GetDescendants()) do
                To = "BasePart"
                if vo:IsA(To) then
                    Do = true

                    local environment856 = getfenv()
                    No = environment856.math.clamp(No, 0, 1)
                    return (No * No) * (3 - (2 * No))
                end
                local function No(Oo, ho)
                    local environment857, Zo = getfenv(), (1 - (Oo * Oo)) - (ho * ho)
                    if Zo <= 0 then

            local function Po(uo, mo, Uo)
                local environment895 = getfenv()
                mo %= Uo
                for Bo = 1, #uo - 1, 1 do
                    local Jo, fo = uo[Bo], uo[Bo + 1]
                    if mo >= Jo[1] then
                        if mo <= fo[1] then
                            Bo = environment895.math.max(fo[1] - Jo[1], 0.0001)
                            Uo = jo((mo - Jo[1]) / Bo)
                            return Jo[2] + ((fo[2] - Jo[2]) * Uo)
                        end
                    end
                end
                return uo[#uo][2]
            end
            local function jo(uo, mo, Uo)
                return uo + ((mo - uo) * Uo)
            end

                                if fo.appliedRightShift then

        local function ro(Po, Wo, Jo, fo)

            if v(B) then
                X.valid = false
                X.dirty = true
            end
        end
        X.c1 = U.DescendantAdded:Connect(W)
        X.c2 = U.DescendantRemoving:Connect(W)
    end
    r.unwatch = function(X)
        if X.c1 then
            X.c1:Disconnect()
            X.c1 = nil
        end
        if X.c2 then
            X.c2:Disconnect()
            X.c2 = nil
        end
    end
    r.grab = function(X, U)
        if X.pc ~= U then
            X.pc = U
            X.valid = false
            local W = X.mats
            for B in W, nil, nil do
                if not (B.Parent) then
                    W[B] = nil
                end
            end
            X:watch(U)
        end
        local W = X.parts
        if not (X.valid) then
            j(W)
            local B = 0
            for J, J in U:GetDescendants() do
                if v(J) then
                    B += 1
                    W[B] = J
                else
                end
            end
            X.valid = true
        end
        return W
    end
    r.save = function(X, U)
        local W, B = X:grab(U), X.mats
        for J = 1, #W, 1 do
            U = W[J]
            if not (B[U]) then
                if v(U) then
                    X = {mat = U.Material, col = U.Color, refl = U.Reflectance}
                    if U:IsA("MeshPart") then
                        local f, M = pcall(c, U)
                        if f then
                            X.tex = M
                        end
                    end
                    J = U:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
                    if J then
                        X.mesh = J
                        X.mtex = J.TextureId
                    end
                    X.sa = U:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceAppearance")
                    local c = U.MaterialVariant
                    if c ~= "" then
                        X.var = c
                    end
                    B[U] = X
                end
            end
        end
        return W
    end
    r.restore = function(c)
        local X = c.mats
        for c, U in X, nil, nil do
            local W, B = c.Parent ~= nil, U.sa
            if B then
                if W then
                    if B.Parent ~= c then
                        pcall(n, B, "Parent", c)
                    end
                end
            end
            if W then
                c.Material = U.mat
                c.Color = U.col
                c.Reflectance = U.refl
                if U.var then
                    pcall(n, c, "MaterialVariant", U.var)
                end
                if U.tex then
                    pcall(n, c, "TextureID", U.tex)
                end
            end
            c = U.mesh
            if c then
                if c.Parent then
                    if U.mtex then
                        c.TextureId = U.mtex
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        j(X)
    end
    r.paint = function(c, X, U)
        local W, B = c:save(X), c.mats
        for J = 1, #W, 1 do
            c = W[J]
            if v(c) then
                X = B[c]
                if X then
                    J = X.sa
                    if J then
                        if J.Parent then
                            pcall(n, J, "Parent", nil)
                        end
                    end
                    if X.var then
                        pcall(n, c, "MaterialVariant", "")
                    end
                    if X.tex then
                        if X.tex ~= "" then
                            pcall(n, c, "TextureID", "")
                        end
                    end
                    local W = X.mesh
                    if W then
                        if W.Parent then
                            if X.mtex ~= "" then
                                W.TextureId = ""
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                c.Reflectance = 0
                c.Material = d
                c.Color = U
            end
        end
    end
    r.unchrom = function(d)
        local c = d.st
        if c then
            c.model:Destroy()
            d.st = nil
        end
        d.dirty = true
    end
    r.park = function(d, c)
        local X = d.st
        if X then
            if X.up == c then
                return
            end
        else
            return
        end
        X.up = c
        X.model.Parent = (c and X.world) or nil
        X.hide = nil
        if c then
            X.tick = y
        end
    end
    r.chrom = function(d, c, X)
        local U = d:grab(c)
        local W, B = #U, d.st
        if ((if B then B.char ~= c else not B) or d.dirty) or (B.count ~= W) then
            d:unchrom()
            local J, f = E(), Instance.new("Model")
            f.Name = "\000"
            B = {char = c, model = f, world = J, src = {}, cfs = {}, hid = {}, list = {}, n = 0, count = W, col = X, up = false, tick = y}
            local E, M = {}, 0
            for G, G in c:GetChildren() do
                if G:IsA("CharacterMesh") then
                    M += 1
                    E[M] = G
                else
                end
            end
            if M > 0 then
                J = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local c = (J and J:Clone()) or Instance.new("Humanoid")
                c:ClearAllChildren()
                c.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
                c.Parent = f
                for G = 1, M, 1 do
                    c = E[G]:Clone()
                    c.BaseTextureId = 0
                    c.OverlayTextureId = 0
                    c.Parent = f
                end
            end
            local c, M, G, g, a = B.src, B.cfs, B.hid, B.list, 0
            for H = 1, W, 1 do
                E = U[H]
                if v(E) then
                    if D(E) then
                    else
                        J = b(E, X)
                        if J then
                            H = a + 1
                            c[H] = E
                            M[H] = J.CFrame
                            G[H] = false
                            g[H] = J
                            J.Parent = f
                            a = H
                        else
                        end
                    end
                else
                end
            end
            B.n = a
            d.st = B
            d.dirty = false
        elseif B.col ~= X then
            B.col = X
            local d = B.list
            for c = 1, B.n, 1 do
                d[c].Color = X
            end
        end
    end
    r.unflat = function(d)
        if d.om then
            d.om:Destroy()
            d.om = nil
        end
        if d.vh then
            d.vh:Destroy()
            d.vh = nil
        end
        if d.oh then
            d.oh:Destroy()
            d.oh = nil
        end
        d.fch = nil
    end
    r.flat = function(d, c, X, E)
        if not (c:IsDescendantOf(L)) then
            d:unflat()
            return
        end
        if ((d.fch ~= c) or not d.om) or not d.om.Parent then
            d:unflat()
            d.fch = c
            local b = Instance.new("Model")
            b.Name = "ChamsChr"
            local U = d:grab(c)
            for W = 1, #U, 1 do
                local B = U[W]
                W = (v(B) and not D(B)) and T(B)
                if W then
                    W:ClearAllChildren()
                    W.Anchored = false
                    W.CanCollide = false
                    W.CanQuery = false
                    W.CanTouch = false
                    W.Massless = true
                    W.CastShadow = false
                    W.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                    if W:IsA("MeshPart") then
                        pcall(n, W, "TextureID", "")
                    end
                    W.Size = W.Size * 0.99
                    W.CFrame = B.CFrame
                    W.Parent = b
                    local v = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                    v.Part0 = W
                    v.Part1 = B
                    v.Parent = W
                end
            end
            b.Parent = L
            d.om = b
            U = Instance.new("Highlight")
            U.DepthMode = e
            U.OutlineTransparency = 1
            U.Adornee = c
            U.Parent = F.fold
            d.vh = U
            U = Instance.new("Highlight")
            U.DepthMode = A
            U.OutlineTransparency = 1
            U.Adornee = b
            U.Parent = F.fold
            d.oh = U
        end
        local L, v = d.vh, d.oh
        L.FillColor = X[1]
        L.FillTransparency = X[2]
        v.FillColor = E[1]
        v.FillTransparency = E[2]
    end
    r.wipe = function(L)
        L:unchrom()
        L:unflat()
        L:restore()
    end
    r.upd = function(L, v)
        local D, T = L.hl, L.plr
        if not (T.Parent) then
            if L.lit ~= false then
                L.lit = false
                D.Enabled = false
            end
            L.mode = nil
            L:wipe()
            return
        end
        local n, d = F.share(T), z.set
        local z, c, X = n.char, n.role, n.fake ~= nil
        local E = ((n.on and d.glow) and not X) and ((c ~= "inno") or not (d.only or d.glow_only))
        if L.lit ~= E then
            L.lit = E
            D.Enabled = E
        end
        if E then
            local E, b, U = d.glow_fill[c], d.glow_out[c], (d.glow_wall and A) or e
            if L.ad ~= z then
                L.ad = z
                D.Adornee = z
            end
            if L.dm ~= U then
                L.dm = U
                D.DepthMode = U
            end
            if L.gfc ~= E[1] then
                L.gfc = E[1]
                D.FillColor = E[1]
            end
            if L.gft ~= E[2] then
                L.gft = E[2]
                D.FillTransparency = E[2]
            end
            if L.goc ~= b[1] then
                L.goc = b[1]
                D.OutlineColor = b[1]
            end
            if L.got ~= b[2] then
                L.got = b[2]
                D.OutlineTransparency = b[2]
            end
        end
        D = ((((n.on and d.mat) and (T ~= C)) and (((c ~= "inno") or X) or not (d.only or d.mat_only))) and d.mat_type) or nil
        L.mode = D
        L.acc = L.acc + v
        if L.acc < 0.15 then
            return
        end
        L.acc = 0
        if D == "Flat" then
            L:unchrom()
            L:restore()
            if X then
                L:unflat()
            else
                L:flat(z, d.mat_vis[c], d.mat_occ[c])
            end
        elseif D == "Chromatic" then
            L:unflat()
            L:restore()
            if X then
                L:unchrom()
            else
                L:chrom(z, d.mat_col[c])
            end
        elseif D then
            L:unchrom()
            L:unflat()
            L:paint(z, d.mat_col[c])
        else
            L:wipe()
        end
    end
    r.ren = function(z)
        local C = z.st
        if not (C) then
            return
        end
        local L = F.share(z.plr)
        if z.mode ~= "Chromatic" then

            return

            return

            z:park(false)
            return

        L = x()
        if not L then
            z:park(false)
            return
        end
        local F, v = C.char, C.root
        if if v then v.Parent ~= F else not v then
            v = (F:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or F:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")) or F:FindFirstChild("Torso")
            v = v and (if v:IsA("BasePart") then v else nil)
            C.root = v
        else
        end
        if not (v) then
            z:park(false)
            return
        end
        F = L:WorldToViewportPoint(v.Position)
        if ((((F.Z > 0) and (F.X > -P)) and (F.X < m.mx)) and (F.Y > -_)) and (F.Y < m.my) then
            C.hide = nil
            if not (C.up) then
                if not (w()) then
                    return
                end
                z:park(true)
            end
        elseif C.up then
            L = C.hide
            if L then
                if s.frame >= L then
                    z:park(false)
                    return
                end
            else
                C.hide = s.frame + u
            end
        else
            return
        end
        F = C.n
        if F == 0 then
            return
        end
        z = C.tick + 1
        L = z >= y
        C.tick = (L and 0) or z
        local s, v, D, T = C.src, C.cfs, C.hid, C.list
        for n = 1, F, 1 do
            C, z = s[n], D[n]
            if L then
                local F = C.Parent
                local s = (if F then C.Transparency >= 1 else not F) or (C.LocalTransparencyModifier >= 1)
                if z ~= s then
                    D[n] = s
                    T[n].Transparency = (s and 1) or K
                    z = s
                else
                end
            else
            end
            if not z then
                local F = C.CFrame
                if v[n] ~= F then
                    v[n] = F
                    T[n].CFrame = F
                end
            end
        end
    end
    r.dest = function(F)
        F.hl:Destroy()
        F:wipe()
        F:unwatch()
        j(F)
    end
    return r
end)()
end
